findings.reason: the four-parameter signature is itself unambiguous and the lift lookup it enables is already described (an undeclared group is refused, as group_position does), so an implementer copies the signature as written; the "three inputs" wording is a slip, not a mechanism the node would build wrongly.
findings.text: `effective_budget(config, *, group, readings, now, session)` is introduced as taking "three inputs" and the three named are readings, now and session; `group` is in the signature but never explained, so the declaration and its own prose disagree on the resolver's arity
